representation.signal_unit: unique ticker + signal date; overlapping candidate families/horizons become bitmasks rather than duplicate trades
representation.entry_rule: GA selects 1-4 generic causal conditions and k-of-n concurrence
representation.exit_rule: GA independently selects 1-4 generic causal conditions and k-of-n concurrence
representation.condition_form: feature <= or >= development-distribution quantile; direction and quantile are genes

feature_language: OFR Funding lagged two business days
OFR Credit lagged two business days

execution.entry: after a causal entry condition is observed at a close, enter next available session open
execution.exit: after causal exit condition is observed at a close, exit next available session open; otherwise exit at maximum-hold close
